| Slite | Knowledge management |  Standard: $8/user/mo (billed annually)  Knowledge Suite: $20/user/mo (billed annually)  Enterprise: Custom |  AI search assistance  Real-time collaboration  Third-party integrations for knowledge base management | [...] OnlyOffice is a security-first, open-source platform with a full suite of collaboration and document management tools. 

OnlyOffice Docs, their document creation suite, is explicitly marketed as a Google Docs alternative. It provides compatibility with a range of file formats (including Microsoft Office files), superior performance with large files, and advanced formatting options that rival Microsoft Word.

The platform’s collaboration suite, OnlyOffice DocSpace, offers real-time co-editing and chat, virtual data rooms for secure storage of sensitive information, and AI assistance. Users can implement a variety of third-party plugins to extend their capabilities, including translation tools, grammar checkers, video embedders, and more.
